data.raw_text:
Traffic Advisory from the Government of Telangana, Police Department, Cyberabad Traffic Wing. 

Due to forecasts of heavy to very heavy rainfall, IT companies and organizations in Cyberabad are advised to consider Work From Home (#WFH) on 14th August 2025.

To:

Ensure safety and productivity

Prevent severe traffic congestion

Maintain uninterrupted emergency services

Minimize travel risks and reduce pressure on road infrastructure

The Joint Commissioner of Police, Traffic, Cyberabad, has requested cooperation and understanding from all concerned.
